name: us-lobbying-mcp-server
description: Search US lobbying disclosures and foreign-agent registrations via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

USLOBBYING_LDA_API_KEY.title: LDA API token
USLOBBYING_LDA_API_KEY.description: Optional registered LDA token for the authenticated request allowance. Anonymous access works without a token.

USLOBBYING_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable table deletion
USLOBBYING_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Expose the local dataframe table deletion tool. SQL canvases are unavailable in this bundle.
